# Eligoo — AI Employees. Work From Cloud.

> Eligoo provides role-based AI employees for growth: strategy, content, creative,
> prospect intelligence, outbound and revenue operations — led by Atlas, an AI
> growth operations manager. Businesses hire AI employees with defined decisions,
> deliverables, KPIs and approval boundaries instead of buying software seats.

## Pages

- [Home](https://eligoo.in/): Hire AI employees and build an AI workforce that works from the cloud.
- [Blog](https://eligoo.in/blog): Playbooks and product updates on AI employees and growth operations.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://eligoo.in/p/terms-and-conditions): Terms of service.
- [Privacy Policy](https://eligoo.in/p/privacy-policy): Privacy policy.
- [Sitemap](https://eligoo.in/sitemap.xml): Full list of indexable pages.

## The AI employees

- Atlas — AI Growth Operations Manager: turns business objectives into operating plans and coordinates the workforce.
- Maven — Market, Brand & Campaign Strategist: positioning, messaging and campaign strategy.
- Sage — Content & Organic Growth Manager: plans, writes and publishes content.
- Pixel — Creative Production Agent: images, video and ad creatives.
- Radar — Prospect Intelligence Agent: finds and verifies ideal-fit prospects.
- Hook — Outbound & Meeting Agent: personalised outreach, replies and meeting booking.
- Ledger — CRM & Revenue Intelligence Analyst: clean CRM, attribution and forecasts.
